Go programming rules for 'openhue-cli'. Adhere to idiomatic Go practices (effective Go). Use standard library where possible (fmt, errors, net/http, testing, etc.). Mandatory error checking for all fallible operations. Use `errors.Wrap` or similar for adding context to errors. Use Go modules (`go.mod`/`go.sum`). Comprehensive unit tests via `testing` package for core logic. Follow Go naming conventions (camelCase/PascalCase). Run `go fmt` and `go vet` on changed files.
General code quality standards. Prioritize readability: Clear names, minimal complexity, SRP for functions. Provide Go doc comments for all exported entities and complex internal logic. Maintain project structure (`cmd/`, `openhue/`, `util/`).
Documentation standards and templates.
- {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS}: {mode} - {action_summary} [Confidence: {confidence_percent}%] [Files: {file_list}] ## Plan Approved {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS}\n\n**Goal:** {goal}\n**Plan:** {plan_summary}\n**Confidence:** {confidence_percent}%\n**Key Decisions:** {decision1} - [ ] {task_description} (Added: {YYYY-MM-DD}) ### Decision ({YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS})\n**Context:** {context}\n**Decision:** {decision}\n**Rationale:** {rationale}\n**Alternatives:** {alternatives} ### Session Summary ({YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS})\n**Progress:** {summary_of_progress}\n**Open Questions:** {list_of_questions}\n**Next Step:** {proposed_next_step}
Use ISO 8601 format for timestamps: {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS}. Ensure logs/notes are concise but capture essential information (what, why, outcome).
Rules for managing tasks in `.notes/task_list.md`.
Format: Markdown checklist (`- [ ]` or `- [x]`). Hierarchy: Use indentation for subtasks. Status Consistency: Parent `[x]` iff ALL direct children `[x]`. Update parent status when children change. Blocking Issues: Maintain `# Blocking Issues` section at the top for tasks preventing progress.
Guidelines specific to the OpenHue CLI project.
Core Logic Location: Implement core Hue Bridge interactions within the `openhue/` package. Command Structure: Use `cobra` library following patterns in `cmd/`. API Reference: Assume access to Philips Hue API documentation; refer to it for endpoint details. Backward Compatibility: Analyze potential impact on existing users before changing commands/flags. README Updates: Update usage examples in `README.md` for new/changed features. Cross-Platform: Consider basic compatibility for Windows, macOS, Linux.
